description: Free and cheap support services, with opening hours, public transport and parking options (Helping Out) is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Melbourne. The City of Melbourne's Helping Out booklet provides a list of free and cheap support services available from more than 70 organisations. The list includes food, accommodation, health services, drug and alcohol services, and legal advice. Coverage: City of Melbourne. The portal files it under the publisher City of Melbourne. Its tags are assistance, food, help, homeless, services. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, JSON, KML, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-06 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other open licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
